For my use its pretty good. I didn't need color accuracy, I just needed a second screen which was slightly bigger than my 14inch laptop; this screen at 15.6inches matched the requirement on budget. Giving 5 star because Amazon never published my review with negative comments.I was searching for a portable monitor and after several month's research I found it just released in Amazon platform. Initially it was cheaper than today's price and I was lucky to get it at Rupees 6532 only. Now my review after few hour of usage,Packaging was very good but the Amazon guy was handling it as it was an unbreakable thing. Luckily nothing bad happened and I got my product intact without any damage.Buid quality is excellent. Very thin build and thin bezel also. It comes with one piece of USB C o USB C type cable and another HDMI to HDMI cable ( Not mini HDMI ) as they equipped a full size HDMI port. Two USB C port - one for power and direct display through USB C from laptop and mobile, other port is for connecting other devices. At the right side there are control switches and one 3.5 mm headphone jack.Sound quality is not as loud as a mobile phone can make. I think it is sufficient for official video chat and YouTube video, but don’t expect much more from two 1 watt speakers.Monitor viewing angle is good but not good colour accuracy.Finally, it is a satisfactory monitor if you are not going to work with photo editing. At this price point this monitor is satisfactory.

Buy this if you need a portable monitor that you want to carry around. The screen is light weight and built well, however the inbuilt kick stand is very flimsy. I think it might break soon if you keep opening the closing the stand.I want to highlight this useful feature that i did not find in other reviews. The monitor includes two USB‑C ports and one full‑size HDMI input. When connected to a laptop via USB‑C, the monitor doesn’t require a separate power adapter because it can draw power directly from the laptop.A great feature of this setup is that you can plug your USB‑C charger into the monitor, and the monitor will pass power through to the laptop using the second USB‑C port. This allows for a clean, single‑cable connection for both display and charging.Package was excellent. There was no amazon box though. 3 year ACER India warranty is a plus. Brightness is adequate. Again, if portability is needed, buy this. Else it is expensive for what it has to offer. You can buy a good big 24 inch FHD monitor for this price.
